meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein women ke liye **kurta sets** kharidne ke liye aap in brands ko shortlist kar sakte ho: **Libas, Biba, W for Woman, Aurelia, Janasya, Aachho, Jaipur Kurti, Lakshita, Varanga,** aur **House of Indya/Indya**.[1][2][6][7][9][10][11][14][19]

Agar aap choice ko style aur budget ke hisaab se narrow karna chahte ho, to ye useful hai:

| Brand | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Libas** | Everyday se festive tak | Straight cotton, A-line, Anarkali, woven aur embroidered sets milte hain.[1][15][17] |
| **Biba** | Trendy ethnic wear | Brand site par kurta sets ka dedicated collection hai.[6] |
| **W for Woman** | 2 & 3 pc sets | Vibrant kurta sets collection list ki gayi hai.[2] |
| **Aurelia** | Versatile wardrobe staples | Kurta sets collection available hai.[9] |
| **Janasya** | Wide size range | Regular sizes se plus-size, XS to 6XL tak mention hai.[11] |
| **Aachho** | Festive / stylish prints | Traditional aur contemporary dono styles milte hain.[10] |
| **Jaipur Kurti** | Affordable dailywear + party wear | Simple aur party-wear dono options milte hain.[14] |
| **Lakshita** | Mid-range stylish sets | Georgette, rayon, viscose co-ord/kurta sets listed hain.[7] |

Agar aap **budget-friendly** option chahte ho, to **Aachho, Anayna, Janasya, Jaipur Kurti,** aur **Meesho** dekh sakte ho, kyunki in listings mein kaafi options lower price range mein dikh rahe hain.[8][10][11][14][5]

Agar aap **premium/designer** look chahte ho, to **Ensemble** aur **Pernia’s Pop Up Shop** better options hain.[12][20]

Aap agar chaho, main aapke liye **budget, occasion, aur fabric** ke hisaab se *top 5 best kurta set brands* bhi sort karke de sakta hoon.
